title: Pixel-art roof tiles in overlapping courses
purpose: Generate a tileable pixel-art roof at a chosen art resolution: courses laid from the eaves up with square, round fish-scale or pointed tile ends, cast shadows on the course below, lit and shaded edges, tints, wood grain and moss, with per-pixel normal, height, roughness and occlusion maps. Use for 2D houses.

contract.signature: generate(width=256, height=256, seed=0, preset="default", directx_normal=False, **parameters) -> {map name: {"channels", "colour_space", "pixels"}}
contract.command_line: python pixel_roof_tiles.py --size 1024 --seed 7 --preset NAME --out DIR [--width W --height H] [--set NAME=VALUE] [--directx-normal] [--orm]

parameters.name: art_pixels
parameters.meaning: Art pixels along each side of the tile; the maps enlarge them with nearest-neighbour sampling.

parameters.name: course_pairs
parameters.meaning: Pairs of tile courses down the tile (the course count is twice this, so the offset repeats).

parameters.name: tiles_per_course
parameters.meaning: Roof tiles across the tile width in each course.

parameters.name: end_shape
parameters.meaning: Tile end: 0 square, 1 round (fish scale), 2 pointed.

parameters.name: overlap
parameters.meaning: How far each tile reaches over the course below, as a share of the course height.

parameters.name: grain
parameters.meaning: 1 draws wood grain lines and gives the tiles random widths (shingles and shakes).

parameters.name: moss
parameters.meaning: Moss growing in the shadowed overlaps.

parameters.name: relief
parameters.meaning: Strength of the per-pixel normal map.

parameters.name: hue_shift
parameters.meaning: Hue rotation of the albedo in turns.

presets.name: default
presets.description: Terracotta fish-scale roof tiles with round ends.

presets.name: verdigris_scales
presets.description: Green copper scales with pointed ends.

presets.name: wooden_shingles
presets.description: Brown wooden shingles of random widths with grain and moss.

limits: Stylized pixel art with the light from the top left baked into the tile edges and shadows; it shows a flat roof plane, with no ridges, valleys, hips or eaves. Every other course shifts by half a tile, so the course count is even. Tile ends are three fixed shapes, and wooden shingles vary only in width. Roughness and height are values per drawn class, and the normal map treats each art pixel as a flat facet. Output sizes that are not a whole multiple of art_pixels give art pixels of unequal widths. Occlusion is a blurred-height estimate posterized to eighths.
technique_references: Course painting from the eaves upward with a cyclic overlap on a torus
Tile ends cut as square, elliptical or pointed shapes
Cast shadow one pixel below each tile end
